title: Syncify settings registry
description: Lists, per Spicetify extension, theme or custom app, which saved keys hold its settings, so Syncify can back them up and sync them between a person's devices.

format.description: Version of this file's format. Syncify skips a registry whose format it doesn't know.

sizes.description: Bytes each size tier allows for one item's synced settings.

accountLimit.description: Bytes of synced settings one account can hold across all its items.

items.description: One entry per item, sorted by id.

key.description: An exact key name, or a prefix ending in * that matches every key starting with it.

id.description: The item's Marketplace id, {user}/{repo}/{path}, as in its marketplace:installed: key. The path is the manifest's main for an extension, usercss for a theme, and the name with spaces as dashes for a custom app.

addedBy.description: owner: submitted by the GitHub account that owns the item's repo, or a public member of the organization that owns it. syncify: a placeholder Syncify added, which the owner's own entry replaces.

storage.description: Where the item saves the keys. localStorage when left out.

valueField.description: When each record is an object, the field that holds the value. Left out when records are the values themselves.

keys.description: The keys that hold the item's settings. Never caches, and never keys shared with Spicetify, Marketplace or other items.

exclude.description: Keys that never leave the device, not in backups and not in sync, such as API keys and tokens. They win over keys.

lists.description: Keys whose value is a list that people add to. Changes on two devices merge instead of the newest replacing the other. object: a JSON object, merged by member name. array: a JSON array of objects, merged by the field named in id.

size.description: The item's size tier. medium when left out.

sizeReason.description: Why the item needs large. Required for large unless the owner added the entry.

discover.description: The owner lists the item on Discover. Owner entries only.
